title: helictotrichon newtonii
intro: Helictotrichon newtonii, commonly known as Newton's feather grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Helictotrichon newtonii include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
